The '''Banqueting Rotunda''' was a squat building located next to the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] on the banks of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

==History==
Construction of the Banqueting Rotunda began shortly after being commissioned by the [[Earl of Vis/Legends|Earl of Vis]], first cousin to the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]]. A squat building with stately columns and an adjacent tower, the banqueting hall was located off of [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] within walking distance of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]].<ref name="SWCL" />
